name: Clean Air Act Amendments
description: Expanded Clean Air Act to regulate hazardous air pollutants (HAPs), added Title V permits, and targeted industrial emissions.

name: TRI Industry Expansion
description: TRI program expanded to include additional sectors like metal mining and electric utilities.

name: PBT Chemical Reporting Added
description: Added Persistent, Bioaccumulative, and Toxic (PBT) chemicals to TRI reporting requirements.

name: Clean Air Mercury Rule (CAMR)
description: Established a cap-and-trade program to reduce mercury emissions from coal-fired power plants.

name: CAMR Vacated
description: D.C. Circuit Court vacated the Clean Air Mercury Rule.

name: Mercury and Air Toxics Standards (MATS)
description: Imposed strict mercury and air toxic emission limits on coal- and oil-fired power plants.

name: Clean Power Plan
description: Aimed to reduce CO2 emissions from power plants to 78% of 2005 levels by 2030.

name: CPP Repealed
description: Clean Power Plan repealed after US left Paris Climate Agreement.
